# Slash Medical

> Wholesale FDA-approved drug test kits and medical supplies with 400+ SKUs for workplace compliance, harm reduction, and clinical screening.

Slash Medical is a leading wholesale distributor of drug testing products including multi-panel test cups, dip cards, and rapid COVID-19 tests. The company specializes in CLIA-waived testing solutions with proprietary products like FENTASCAN for fentanyl detection, serving employers, clinics, and harm reduction organizations.
